name: spear
why: The spear (gearlook.js PROC 'spear'), made by Tripo in place of the one procgear.js builds in code on the knight's sword mount.

image.prompt: Stylized low-poly fantasy spear, a single game prop shown whole, standing perfectly upright and vertical with the point at the top, centered, seen from the side. Long straight sturdy wooden shaft with a wrapped leather grip at the middle and a small round iron cap at the foot. A broad leaf-shaped steel spearhead on top, with a thick socket bound by a thin gold band. Chunky readable shapes, a big spearhead, a thick shaft, hand-painted flat colours with soft light-to-dark gradients, no texture noise, no harsh shadows. Game-ready prop in the style of KayKit adventurers. Plain light grey background, nothing else in the picture. --no hands, character, text, multiple objects, ribbons, feathers, tassels
